product_metadata.title: AerWo 4 Pack Egg Rings Non-Stick Egg Mold Shaper, Stainless Steel Egg Rings for Frying Egg Mcmuffins, 3 Inch Round Egg Cooker Ring with Oil Brush, Pancake Mold for Griddle Cooking
features: 【Quick and Easy Breakfast】Busy morning, craving for a rich and delicious breakfast? Use the ring to brush butter and put it in the frying pan to quickly preheat it. Put the eggs in the ring, butter the English muffins, drink a cup of coffee, and then break the door with a delicious and healthy egg sandwich to complete a delicious breakfast in 3 minutes

【Non-Stick Egg Rings】Our egg circle rings are made of food-grade stainless steel, BPA-free, heat resistance up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit, durable, do not deform, have anti-rust and non-stick coatings, so there is no need to worry about food sticking to the egg ring during cooking. Dishwasher safe, easy to release and clean

【Anti-scald Egg Molds】This egg poacher is designed with a foldable silicone handle. The silicone material is heat-resistant and scalding, which can prevent finger burns. do not become hot while cooking to make using them a breeze. Its folding handle is easy to use and store

【Egg Griddle Ring Use】Put the frying egg rings on a flat pan, add some oil into the ring mold with low heat, set your rings in the pan for longer than the required 30 seconds to heat up. This will keep eggs in good shape without leaking out. Once the bottom is cooked, remove the frying egg ring and flip, you will get a perfect omelette

【Multi-functional Tools】Don’t stop at the eggs, the egg ring is also very suitable for making mini pancakes, burgers, sandwiches, English muffins and other foods. Deep enough to easily add extras like veggies, cheese, or cooked ham or bacon. Your breakfast will be richer and more varied. The possibilities are endless! Yum!
